# Anarchy

Anarchy gives Obsidian a bold, high-contrast look, with clear typography and strong accent colours recorded as serving readability. The same styling is carried across editor panes and the surrounding interface. Its palette, modes and settings are not recorded beyond that.

![Anarchy screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niedzielawieczur/Anarchy/HEAD/Screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Anarchy"
    author: "niedzielawieczur"
    repo:   "niedzielawieczur/Anarchy"
    slug:   "anarchy"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/anarchy"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/niedzielawieczur/Anarchy"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niedzielawieczur/Anarchy/HEAD/Screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a bold, high-contrast visual style to Obsidian with clear typography and strong accent colors for improved readability. Create a cohesive, modern look across editor panes and UI to keep focus on your notes."
}
```
